title: Session start failed: clock not synchronized or other error
symptom: Started to get this error out of the blue last week. Tried restarting the sensor and even doing a hard reset of the transmitter with no luck. Eventually tried a brand new sensor and still the same error.
fix: Ended up getting a replacement transmitter as nothing else seemed to work.
